inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "Empty Bloodridge sunken crypt battle stage, rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars with the cheerful brightness of a storybook strategy game: a bright late afternoon, a clear blue sky with a few white clouds, warm sunlight on white marble ruins overgrown with vines and flowers, saturated cheerful colours, crisp bold shapes, rays of light through golden leaves, cool blue shadows, fireflies.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "modern high quality pixel art battle stage, golden hour light, lush, harmonious colour", "lighting": "Warm late afternoon sunlight from the upper left, cool blue shadows, as discrete flat pixel colour planes, the arena in calm even light shade.", "color_palette": ["#5aa6e4", "#b0daf0", "#ffffff", "#6290d2", "#fad096", "#9692c4", "#f6e4c4", "#7c78aa", "#ecb050", "#b46e3c", "#56925c", "#96a0bc", "#1c4246", "#282848"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "One continuous 2.5D battle stage seen from a fixed side oblique camera like a classic arcade game stage, no figures, no text. The top third is sky over a distant ridge. Along the back stands a row of ruins: an obelisk at the far left, a broken colonnade, the temple crypt in the middle with a brazier each side of its doorway, a ruined hut with ladders, a huge tree at the right, with coffins, a cart of skulls and pots in front of them. The lower two thirds is one wide open flat arena floor where two armies will stand, calm and even. A fallen column and a giant fallen statue head frame the bottom corners in shadow.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 0, 420, 105], "desc": "a tall white marble obelisk wrapped in flowering vines"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [130, 55, 410, 325], "desc": "a white marble colonnade overgrown with vines and flowers, a red banner"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 370, 430, 635], "desc": "a white marble temple crypt glowing in warm sunlight, a dark doorway, two braziers"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [140, 600, 420, 860], "desc": "a ruined stone hut with wooden ladders and hanging plants"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 790, 420, 1000], "desc": "a huge tree with golden autumn leaves and light shafts through its canopy"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [300, 250, 470, 1000], "desc": "old coffins, a cart of skulls, clay pots and crates in warm light"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 0, 330, 1000], "desc": "a bright blue late afternoon sky with a few white clouds over violet mountains and a stepped pyramid"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [420, 60, 1000, 940], "desc": "a calm pale stone arena in cool blue shade with grass along its edges"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [820, 0, 1000, 230], "desc": "dark teal foliage and a fallen column"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [800, 830, 1000, 1000], "desc": "a giant marble statue head lying among ferns"}]}}
